title: July CPI Crucial as Inflation Rebound Concerns Rise
title_cn: 通胀反弹担忧加剧，7 月 CPI 至关重要
summary: Barclays US economist Pooja Sriram discussed expectations for the upcoming July Consumer Price Index (CPI) report, emphasizing that the recent softer inflation reading in June is likely to be short-lived. She noted that while the July CPI data may not be decisive on its own, it remains a critical data point for markets and policymakers, especially following last Friday's relatively soft payrolls report which eased concerns about a reacceleration in economic activity. Sriram highlighted that inflation data will play a key role in shaping expectations ahead of the Federal Reserve's next meeting, with all eyes on whether inflation rebounds as anticipated. The segment underscored the significance of CPI and PPI data as the next major test for the Fed's policy direction. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fed Expected to Keep Raising Rates Until Inflation Cools
title_cn: 美联储预计将继续加息直至通胀降温
summary: Kelsey Berro, Fixed Income Portfolio Manager at JPMorgan Asset Management, discussed the Federal Reserve's challenging position amid recent disinflationary signals. Despite expectations for a modest 0.2% month-over-month increase in core CPI and relatively moderate inflation rates over several time horizons, the Fed remains cautious due to core PCE inflation running above 3%. Berro emphasized that a single data point will not dictate the Fed's next move, especially with key economic reports such as CPI, PPI, and payrolls scheduled in the coming weeks, alongside the upcoming Jackson Hole symposium. The market continues to price in potential rate hikes, reflecting the Fed's possible strategy of implementing 'insurance hikes' if inflation data remains elevated and the labor market stable. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Unpriced Food Inflation Threatens Volatile Bond Market
title_cn: 无价食品通胀威胁波动的债券市场
summary: Marie-Anne Allier, Fixed Income Fund Manager at Carmignac Gestion, discussed the current challenges facing bond markets amid rising energy prices and geopolitical tensions involving Iran. She noted that much of the negative impact from higher oil, gas, and energy prices is already priced into the market, with expectations of fewer interest rate cuts and potential hikes in the US and Europe. However, Allier highlighted a looming risk that is not yet fully reflected in bond prices: food inflation. She pointed to adverse weather conditions affecting harvests, disruptions to Ukraine's grain exports due to the conflict with Russia, and the potential volatility from El Niño as factors likely to trigger a new supply shock in food prices within the next six to twelve months. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Kennedy Center Must Pay Musician $250,000 in Trump Name Spat
title_cn: 特朗普名字纠纷中肯尼迪中心必须向音乐家支付 25 万美元
summary: The John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts in Washington was ordered to pay more than $250,000 in legal fees to a musician who canceled a Christmas Eve concert over the venue’s move to add President Donald Trump’s name.

title: US Criticizes China Over Nuclear Missile Test in Pacific Ocean
title_cn: 美国批评中国在太平洋进行核导弹试验
summary: The US criticized China for not giving sufficient notice before testing an intercontinental ballistic missile in the Pacific Ocean last month, as the Trump administration pushes back against Beijing’s growing nuclear arsenal.

title: US Golden Dome Office Invites Industry Input Via Online Portal
title_cn: 美国金顶办公室通过在线门户邀请行业参与
summary: The Pentagon opened an online portal for industry competitors to submit ideas and requests for information for the $185 billion Golden Dome program, in the latest effort to shake up traditional defense procurement competition.

title: Colombia Earthquake: Search for Survivors Underway as Death Toll Nears 170
title_cn: 哥伦比亚地震：死亡人数接近 170 人，正在搜寻幸存者
summary: Colombia’s government plans to declare an economic emergency to bolster its response to a massive earthquake, as the country’s new president faces a tough and early test of his abilities to handle a crisis.

title: Trump’s New Birthright Citizenship Curbs Face Legal Contest
title_cn: 特朗普新的出生权公民身份限制面临法律争议
summary: President Donald Trump’s latest move to restrict automatic citizenship is facing a legal challenge, months after the Supreme Court knocked down his earlier attempt at upending longstanding guarantees for children born in the US to non-citizens.

title: Brazil Assets Slide as Election Worries Start to Grip Investors
title_cn: 由于选举担忧开始困扰投资者，巴西资产下滑
summary: Brazilian assets lagged global peers on Tuesday as political concerns start to weigh on investor sentiment two months before the presidential election.

title: Fast-Tracked Deportations for Migrants Permitted by Court
title_cn: 法院允许的移民快速驱逐出境
summary: A federal appeals court cleared the way for the Trump administration to revive directives that put hundreds of thousands of migrants at risk to be deported under a fast-tracked process.

title: Trump Says Russia Released Imprisoned Former Marine
title_cn: 特朗普称俄罗斯释放了被监禁的前海军陆战队员
summary: US President Donald Trump said Russia had released former US Marine Robert Gilman after roughly four years.

title: Key US Munitions ‘Dangerously Low,’ Bloomberg Economics Says
title_cn: 彭博经济研究称美国主要弹药“处于危险的低水平”
summary: The US is running “dangerously low” on the key munitions used during the war against Iran, according to a Bloomberg Economics report published Tuesday.

title: Candidate Who Said ‘Cancel Thanksgiving’ Leads in Wisconsin Race
title_cn: 说“取消感恩节”的候选人在威斯康星州竞选中领先
summary: Francesca Hong wants to tax the rich and abolish ICE, and she’s drawn recent criticism for expressing disdain for a cherished American holiday.

title: Trump Rhetoric Leaves Hormuz Deal in Limbo
title_cn: 特朗普的言论使霍尔木兹协议陷入困境
summary:
Pakistan’s defense minister said the US and Iran are “close to some sort of arrangement” over the Strait of Hormuz, even after both sides appeared to harden their positions in the long-deadlocked negotiations.
Gautam Mukunda, Lecturer at Yale University and BBG Opinion columnist, discusses how Trump's recent rhetoric has dented Hormuz deal hopes and how it's impacting the Republican party as primaries continue across the country. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Burnham Fast-Tracks Prison Plan Over Cop-Killing Case Uproar
title_cn: 伯纳姆因枪杀警察案引起轩然大波，加快监狱计划
summary: Prime Minister Andy Burnham promised to speed up efforts to create more prison places as he attempted to quell an uproar over an inmate release plan that’s threatening to consume his crucial first weeks in office.
